description: Search dishes on Sydney restaurant and cafe menus and see which are free of allergens. Write the query the way a person would say it: 'gluten free pasta warriewood', 'nut free thai inner west', 'coeliac friendly brunch bondi', 'vegan dumplings surry hills'. Allergen, diet and place words are understood, and so are things a table needs from the venue: 'dog friendly', 'kid friendly', 'outdoor seating', 'private room for 12', 'set menu', 'group bookings', 'harbour view', 'rooftop', 'takes bookings', 'walk in only', 'baby change', 'wheelchair accessible'. Those are hard filters (all of them must hold, as on the website): only venues whose own data says yes are returned, a venue that has not said is never counted, and a party size with a private room leaves out rooms that print a smaller capacity. Each dish shows its status per allergen (free by default, or can be made free with what to ask for, such as 'GF pasta +$4'), the venue, a link, and the day the menu was read.

free_of.description: Optional. Allergens every dish must be free of, free by default or able to be made free: gluten, dairy, nuts, peanut, treenut, egg, soy, sesame, shellfish, fish, seafood, lupin, sulphite. 'coeliac' means gluten. Diets vegetarian and vegan also work.

near.description: Optional place name: a Sydney suburb or region, such as 'Manly' or 'Inner West'. Suburbs and regions mean within 4 km, nearest first. Coordinates as 'lat,lng' also work.

query.description: What to eat, in plain words, including allergens and place. Example: 'gluten free pizza manly'.

name: search_dishes
title: Search dishes
